Keep me under Yours protection O Beloved Master of the Universe and fulfil my faith, O God the World-Lord.
A0GC: Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, when he beholds the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||39||13||15||67||
Slave Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, when he sees God's sight even for an instant.
HLLW: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fifth Mehl:
R3AE: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace He is obtained.
A9QE: One who loves her, is ultimately devoured.
He who loves mammon, him she ultimately devours.
C1ER: One who seats her in comfort, is totally terrified by her.
He, who seats her comfortably, him she greatly terrifies.
LQL4: Siblings, friends and family, beholding her, argue.
Brother, friends and family beholding her, indulge in strife.
3EA0: But she has come under my control, by Guru's Grace. ||1||
But, by Guru's grace, she has come under my control.
5BZW: Seeing such a power of hers, bewitched are,
XW64: the strivers, the Siddhas, the demi-gods, angels and mortals. All, except the Saadhus, are deceived by her deception. ||1||Pause||
the strivers, the men of miracles, gods, super human beings and mortals. Excepting the saints, all are deceived by her deceit. Pause.

Some wander about as ascetics. But they are harassed by lust.
KZCV: Some grow rich as householders, but she does not belong to them.
Some, as family men, amass wealth, but she becomes not their own.
J0SF: Some call themselves men of charity, and she torments them terribly.
Some who call themselves as greatly torments.
1R2Z: The Lord has saved me, by attaching me to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||
God has saved me by attaching me to the True Guru's feet.
NDSJ: She leads astray the penitents who practice penance.
She leads astray the penitents who practise penance.
ZRN8: The scholarly Pandits are all seduced by greed.
All the scholarly Brahmans are seduced by greed.
V2FL: The world of the three qualities is enticed, and the heavens are enticed.
Bewitched are the men of three qualities and bewitched is the heaven.
3QXJ: The True Guru has saved me, by giving me His Hand. ||3||
The True Guru has preserved me by giving his hand.
112K: She is the slave of those who are spiritually wise.
To the divine, she acts as a servant.
15QH: With her palms pressed together, she serves them and offers her prayer:
With clasped hands she serves him and makes the supplication.
M4NH: "Whatever you wish, that is what I shall do."
What you orderest that work I shall do,
S3WJ: O servant Nanak, she does not draw near to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||
and I shall not draw near the Guru-ward, says she. O slave Nanak.
NBEE: I have been separated from my Beloved by Maya (my mother-in-law).
From my mother-in-law (mammon) my Beloved (God) has separated me.
TUS5: Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are dying of grief.
My husband's younger brother's wife, and my husband's elder brother's wife have died of grief and sorrow.
LAR5: I am no longer swayed by the fear of Death (my elder brother-in-law).
I have given up the dependence of my husband's elder brother.
6WPB: I am protected by my All-knowing, Wise Husband Lord. ||1||
My wise and Omniscient Spouse has protected me.
9U7R: Listen, O people: I have tasted the elixir of love.
Hear O people, I have obtained the essence of love.
F8ZP: The evil ones are dead, and my enemies are destroyed. The True Guru has given me the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
I have killed the evil persons and destroyed my enemies. The True Guru has given me the God's Name. Pause.
YC5F: First, I renounced my egotistical love of myself.
Firstly, I have given up the love of pride.
2FQD: Second, I renounced the ways of the world.
Secondly, I have renounced the customs of others.
0LJH: Renouncing the three qualities, I look alike upon friend and enemy.
Abandoning the three qualities, I deem an evil person and a friend the same (alike).

Meeting the saintly Guru I have realised the excellences of the fourth (highest) state of mind.
PD6Q: In the cave of celestial bliss, I have obtained a seat.
In the cave of celestial poise, I have acquired a seat.
7HB0: The Lord of Light plays the unstruck melody of bliss.
God the embodiment of lights, has played for me the celestial music.
FL9Q: I am in ecstasy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Supreme joy I have obtained by meditating on Guru's hymns.
P7BB: Imbued with my Beloved Husband Lord, I am the blessed, happy soul-bride. ||3||
Imbued with my Beloved, I have become a blessed and happy wife.

Slave Nanak utters the meditation of the Lord.
GJK4: one who listens and practices it, is carried across and saved.

He is born not, nor does he die. He comes and goes not.

The bride possesses singular devotion and is amiable.

She is of peerless beauty and of perfectly good character.
7LWY: The house in which she dwells is such a praiseworthy house.
The house, she dwells in, is praiseworthy.
